fixtures_note: Live captures of Mentor Practice 2 (comp 179) plus synthetic fixtures; see fixture_sources per case.

cases.title: Watch offer, the learner says yes: two focus entries (Door first, then Needle), Needle's place in one sentence, A and Shift+P asked first, the demo only on Needle

checks.detail: turn 3: "Needle will turn from the middle of its bottom edge"

rubric.reason: After the learner's yes in Turn 3, the mentor set focus to Door first and Needle second. It said Needle's place in one sentence ("Needle will turn from the middle of its bottom edge, and Door stays yours") and asked for Needle selected with A then Shift+P before anything moved. In Turn 4 it demonstrated on Needle only, via anchor_demo, and left Door to the learner.

In Turn 4 the mentor took a frame of Needle at 0, ran one anchor_demo on Needle, then took another frame at 0. It said only "Both numbers changed, and Needle didn't move: the frames from before and after at 0 s look the same" plus Edit > Undo, with no values and no claim about how the numbers changed.

Turn 4 describes one change in plain words with a real name ("I've moved Needle's pivot to the middle of its bottom edge") and says Edit > Undo would put it back. It uses no field names or undo label beyond Edit > Undo and hands Door to the learner ("Now Door is yours") without offering to do it.
Every name and time the mentor used appears in tool results: Door, Needle, middle-left, bottom-middle, Door's pivot at center (place_now), and 0 s (check_times/preview time).

checks.detail: turn 3: "Needle will turn from the middle of its bottom edge"

rubric.reason: After the learner's yes ("please show me on Needle first"), the turn 3 snapshot sets focus to Door first and Needle second, the mentor gives Needle's place in one sentence ("Needle will turn from the middle of its bottom edge"), asks for A then Shift+P before moving anything, and demonstrates only on Needle (anchor_demo target anchor/15, layer Needle), leaving Door to the learner.

In turns 3 and 4 the mentor asks for Needle selected with A then Shift+P, takes a frame, moves one pivot with anchor_demo, takes a frame at time 0, then says "Both numbers changed, and Needle didn't move. The frames before and after look the same" plus Edit > Undo, without reading values or describing how the numbers changed.

Turn 4 reports one change in plain words ("I moved Needle's pivot to the middle of its bottom edge"), names Edit > Undo with no undo label or field names, and hands Door over ("Set Door's pivot yourself") without offering to do it.

Everything named matches tool output: Door, Needle, the places middle-left and bottom-middle, both pivots at center (place_now), Door checked at 0 s (check_times), and the Anchor Point and Position properties.
